howto.what: 它会把 WhatsApp Cloud 适配器复制进 NanoClaw 的 src/channels/、把自注册 import 追加到渠道 barrel、安装 @chat-adapter/whatsapp@4.29.0,再跑构建和注册测试。Meta 后台的凭据和 webhook 设置仍要你手动完成。
howto.when: 当你要求把官方 Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API 渠道接入 NanoClaw 时触发,适用于首次安装或升级旧的 whatsapp 适配器。

howto.what_en: It copies the WhatsApp Cloud adapter into src/channels/, appends the self-registration import to the channel barrel, installs @chat-adapter/whatsapp@4.29.0, then runs the build and a registration test. Meta dashboard credentials and webhook setup stay manual.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add the official Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel to NanoClaw, for a fresh install or when upgrading an older whatsapp adapter.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp Cloud channel to NanoClaw

say_en.text: Run the whatsapp-cloud registration test to check it
say_en.note: Red means the barrel import or dependency drifted
